**Group:** Diatoms  ·  **Optics:** low-mag

## Defining characteristics

A low-magnification morphotype class for a straight, chain-forming diatoms. This is a catch-all group for chained diatoms that form a straight chains and cannot be keyed into other classes. Key features: straight diatom chains.

## Distinguishing from similar classes

| Similar class | How to tell them apart |
|---|---|
| **diatom_chain_1** | Morphotype 1 diatom chains have large, thick setae. |
| **diatom_chain_2** | Morphotype 2 diatom chains form helical or spiral chains. |
| **thalassiosira** | If seperated disc-shaped chained cells, should be labeled as thalassiosira. |
